description: Image Description: The image features a scenic landscape with two horses grazing on a grassy field. The foreground displays the horses, one dark brown and the other lighter brown, both with shiny coats. The field is expansive, with patches of bare earth and small rocks scattered throughout. In the background, there are mist-covered mountains with rocky slopes, partially obscured by low-hanging clouds. The overall atmosphere is serene and natural, with soft lighting suggesting a cloudy day.
